name: My Girl
source:
You start the game already with a girlfriend, Miki. During the school year, you'll meet other two girls, and you must choose between chasing one of them or sticking with Miki.

[edited from [url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=487&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
translation:
游戏开始时你已经有了一个女朋友美纪。在学年中，你还会遇到另外两个女孩，你必须在追求她们中的一个或继续和美纪在一起之间做出选择。

[编辑自[url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=487&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
